description: ⚠️ WRITE / MUTATING: creates a new issue in Linear. Requires a teamId (from linear_list_teams) and a title. Optional description (markdown), priority (0=none,1=urgent,2=high,3=medium,4=low), and assigneeId. GraphQL: mutation issueCreate.

assigneeId.description: UUID of the user to assign the issue to.

teamId.description: UUID of the team to create the issue in (from linear_list_teams).

name: linear_create_issue
title: Create issue (WRITE — mutates Linear)
